mentions.name: Kubegrade
mentions.description: A Kubernetes (K8s) management platform built on AI agents and smart visualization, aimed at solving real-world cluster issues through generalizable agents.
mentions.problem: Common Kubernetes issues are surprisingly hard to distill into generalizable agents that can solve real-world problems.
mentions.source_excerpt: We are building a K8s management platform based on AI Agents and smart visualization. It's surprisingly hard to distill common issues down to generalizable agents which can solve real world issues but we've made some very exciting progress in the space.
